objective: Bring the live main branch protection in line with the nine-check safety matrix the repository declares, so the declaration is enforced rather than documented.
decision_supported: May the declaration and the live configuration disagree? No: a matrix that is declared but not enforced reports a pass it never observed.
acceptance: The live configuration requires all nine declared checks.
Stale reviews are dismissed on push.
stop_conditions: The change would need the declaration relaxed instead.
risks_and_fallbacks: Enforcing admin bypass means an emergency fix needs the documented audit path; that is what the declaration asks for.
Fallback: restore the previous protection from the issue's record.
